### I use population data to make sense of why outcomes differ across people and places.

I'm a quantitative researcher trained in social epidemiology. Across different topics and settings, I've stayed interested in the same challenge of figuring out what imperfect data can tell us about the world.

[More about me →](about.qmd)

::: py-3
### How I Work

The methods follow from the question. Some problems need causal inference. Others need prediction, segmentation, or descriptive trends. Before modeling, I look at where the data came from, what it can support, and what assumptions I'm making. The analysis isn't done until the finding is translated into something that supports a decision.

:::
